scope.summary: Define the canonical BodySpec type (schema id hsk.tailor.body_spec@1) per Section 13.16 (BK-16.2), closing the REQ-043 stable-addressable-parameter foundation: a serde+schemars struct holding the channels map (stable snake_case channel key -> value), skeleton_def ref (BSK- id), genital config block, skin config block, coupling_links, and recipe refs (BRC- ids). Authority/solver lengths are millimetres; LLM-facing surfaces render centimetres — the unit boundary is encoded in typed helpers, not left to callers.
acceptance_criteria: BodySpec struct exists with fields: body_id (String, "BDY-{uuid_v7}"), channels (BTreeMap<String, f32>), skeleton_def_id (String, "BSK-{uuid_v7}"), genital_config (typed, defaultable), skin_config (typed, defaultable), coupling_links (Vec<CouplingLink>, placeholder type until MT-496), recipe_refs (Vec<String> of BRC- ids), schema_id fixed "hsk.tailor.body_spec@1".
BodySpec derives Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema (schemars), Clone, PartialEq; a schema snapshot test pins the generated JSON Schema so evolution stays additive.

Length-bearing authority fields are documented as mm; helpers mm_to_cm_display / cm_to_mm_authority exist with round-trip tests and the JsonSchema descriptions state 'cm on LLM surfaces, mm in authority'.
Channel keys are validated as stable snake_case ([a-z][a-z0-9_]*) at deserialization; invalid keys produce BodyKitError::Validation, not a panic.
deny_unknown_fields is set so unknown JSON fields are rejected.
scope.risk_if_missed: If BodySpec is loose or unit-ambiguous, every downstream channel, recipe, and export MT inherits an unstable contract; Daz's opaque dial soup with no typed schema is exactly what makes its bodies non-scriptable for LLM/batch workflows (REQ-043).

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
